assets.name: cover
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium cinematic 3D rendered BACKGROUND for a 16:9 automotive safety research presentation. Deep midnight navy #0B1626 seamless environment, cyan #22D3EE luminous accents, realistic clear blue glass and brushed silver. On the RIGHT HALF only: an elegant generic unbranded silver sedan in three-quarter view on a thick transparent glass disc, surrounded by a few vertical translucent blank complaint-document sheets and restrained concentric cyan signal rings. The vehicle is a conceptual model, not a real named model. Sophisticated product-render quality, crisp glass refraction, subtle bloom, elegant studio lighting, no toy/cartoon feel. LEFT HALF must be empty nearly uniform midnight navy for large white Korean headline, no objects or bright lines there. Keep all hero objects within x=55%-97%, y=15%-68%, leaving BOTTOM 28% dark and almost empty for a timeline. Full bleed wide landscape 16:9. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, checkmarks, shields, smoke, fire, charts or rendered UI. This is a conceptual illustration of finding investigation candidates, not defect confirmation.

assets.name: roles
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium restrained 3D rendered illustration as a full-slide BACKGROUND for 16:9 presentation. Midnight navy #0B1626 background, cyan #22D3EE glass edge light and brushed silver, soft subtle amber only on center object. Three independent yet visually consistent glass sculptures in one horizontal row: LEFT at x=20% a stack of blank translucent complaint document sheets passing through a small elegant glass prism; CENTER at x=50% a silver signal-wave sculptural object in a transparent circular ring, NOT a chart and not bars; RIGHT at x=80% a blank open investigation folio with a tilted glass magnifying lens. Each sculpture about 20% canvas width. All objects sit in a shallow band between y=30% and y=56%; top 27% fully empty dark navy, bottom 40% fully empty dark navy for native slide text. Sophisticated product CGI like luxury glass sculpture, subtle contact shadows, gentle luminous filaments, consistent camera angle. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, shields, checkmarks, humans, charts, UI, futuristic robots. The concept is measurement, statistical judgement, human decision with separate responsibilities.
